doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Armstrong, the boats and the downtown halls
title: Manuel Perez's departure, Piron's boat band and Louis joining the boat
summary: Martin explains who took which jobs c. 1918: Manuel Perez's group left, Oliver took Economy Hall, and Piron's boat job went to Joe Howell, who tried Amos Riley before Louis was chosen. Tom adds that Joe Howell later played tuba and bass with his own band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable
